meta.notes: Demon's Souls equipment data, PS5 remake (2020) first. Scraped from Fextralife wiki item pages (all HTTP 200 on 2026-10-30). Stats are base (+0) values as shown on each page; values the wiki shows as '-', '?' or malformed were left out, never guessed. Weapon 'type' is the wiki's Weapon Type (shields: Shield (Standard/Large/Small)). Catalyst/talisman requirements and scaling come from the Catalysts/Talismans list tables. upgradePath sums each weapon's wiki upgrade table: Regular +10 path, each special +5 path with the base level it starts from and the stone, total stone counts, plus any Demon Soul transformation. Variants used in builds (Crescent Estoc, Sharp Uchigatana, Fatal Secret Dagger, etc.) are the base weapon plus that path; exact recipes are in crafting.json. armorSets holds 26 full sets, 3 standalone pieces (Silver Coronet, Monk's Head Wrappings, Silver Bracelet) and 1 'Rings' pseudo-set with all 30 rings. Remake-only gear: Barbarian, Blue-Eye Knight, Burrower's, Imperial Spy, Official's (clothes/gloves/leggings), Penetrator; Boletarian Royalty and Red-Eye Knight are Digital Deluxe Edition. PS3 differences: these remake-only items do not exist on PS3; set gender locks are relaxed in the remake (wiki notes e.g. Binded Cross on Type B).

weapons.name: Dagger
weapons.description: A standard dagger. A slashing weapon that inflicts heavy damage on soft flesh but has a limited effect on metal armor and hard scales. Daggers are very effective after parrying, as well as in close-range stabs from behind.

weapons.description: This versatile single-edged dagger is standard issue for the King's spies. Slashing weapons inflict heavy damage on soft flesh but have a limited effect on metal armor and hard scales. Daggers deal the most damage after parrying, or better yet, stuck squarely in an enemy's back.

weapons.name: Baby's Nail
weapons.description: A dagger treated with plague. The blade is curved like a talon. A dagger often used by women and children for assassination. Among the various unique weapons, this is one of the especially sinister.
weapons.upgradePath: Unique weapon: upgraded with Colorless Demon Souls at Blacksmith Ed (after the Searing Demon Soul), max +5
weapons.location: Found in: Prison of Hope, behind the ceremonial table in the room where you fight Fool's Idol. Be mindful that after the Fool Idol fight, approaching the altar from the front will result in the gargoyles taking you away, so you should approach from the right or left and hug the edges. | Dropped by: Sage Freke, the Visionary

weapons.name: Blueblood Sword
weapons.description: A white iron straight sword born from the soul of the demon Maiden Astraea. The sword of true nobility, endowed with the essential power humans are born with, which increases its attack power.

weapons.location: Can be created at Blacksmith Ed, requires a Pureblood Demon's Soul. | It must be created from the following: Broken Sword +0

weapons.name: Broad Sword
weapons.description: A straight sword with a broad blade designed for slashing. Slashing weapons inflict heavy damage on soft flesh but have a limited effect on metal armour and hard scales. Handily, this sword can also be used for thrusting attacks, which compensates for that particular weakness.

weapons.description: A small straight sword with a broken blade. Completely covered in rust with blood stuck to the blade, its sharpness is negligible.
weapons.location: Found in: Swamp of Sorrow, in one of the islands of the swamp. | Drop by Dregling

weapons.name: Long Sword
weapons.description: A standard straight sword. Straight swords are the most standard and most versatile weapons. In addition to a stable "standard" attack type against most targets, it also has a powerful thrusting attack.

weapons.name: Knight Sword
weapons.description: The straight sword of the Boletarian Knights. Proof of investiture by the King Using Stonefang's hard iron. It is heavier than the standard straight sword, and has higher attack power.

weapons.location: Dropped by: Red Eye Knight | Bought From: Dregling Merchant for 20000 souls. | Found in: The King's Tower, after the Blue Dragon changes position drop to the base of the long staircase to find alongside a Knight's Shield.

weapons.name: Kris Blade
weapons.description: A small ceremonial straight sword. Etched with numerous ancient runes, this sword serves as a catalyst in occult rituals. Amplifies the damage dealt and received by magic.
weapons.upgradePath: Unique weapon: upgraded with Colorless Demon Souls at Blacksmith Ed (after the Searing Demon Soul), max +5
weapons.location: To get the Kris Blade, player must go to Smithing Grounds until the final elevator and take the ramp on the left. At the end will be the Kris Blade on a body.

weapons.name: Penetrating Sword
weapons.description: A long straight sword used by the Penetrator, one of the heroes of Boletaria. As the name states, its thrusts are especially powerful. Because of its irregular size for a straight sword, it requires great strength and technique.
weapons.upgradePath: Unique weapon: upgraded with Colorless Demon Souls at Blacksmith Ed (after the Searing Demon Soul), 5, max +5
weapons.location: Found in: Inner Ward, after fighting the Red Eye Knight patrolling the area, you can drop on a ledge on the right side of the bridge just before the 3 crossbow men | Dropped by: Metas, Knight of the Lance

weapons.name: Rune Sword
weapons.description: A gilded sword crafted with exquisite design. It's physical attack power is close to non-existant, but is strongly magically enhanced and also protects its wielder from magical attacks. It is the weapon of the legendary hero, with it's paired rune shield.
weapons.upgradePath: Unique weapon: upgraded with Colorless Demon Souls at Blacksmith Ed (after the Searing Demon Soul), 5, max +5
weapons.location: Found in: Upper Latria, Can be found on the large tower at the center of the level, the one with the beating heart. Take the stairs up, until you reach some pots on your left and you will notice there's no railing. Break the pots and walk to the edge, you will see a narrow ledge below. Drop carefully and you will find the Rune Sword alongside a Rune Shield. | Defeat Black Phantom Ostrava in The King's Tower (1 - 4). He drops the Rune Sword and the Rune Shield.

weapons.name: Short Sword
weapons.description: A small straight sword. Straight swords are the most standard and most versatile weapons. In addition to a stable "standard" attack type against most targets, it also has a high powered thrusting attack

weapons.location: Bought From: Blacksmith Boldwin for 1000 souls. | Found in: Upper Latria, you can find a Moon Short Sword +1 in the area where you find the Maneater, just on the right side of the stairs that lead to the next zone, go along the ledge to find it.

weapons.name: Bastard Sword
weapons.description: This large sword, similar to a straight sword, is a versatile weapon, but its weight means it usually required the use of both hands. The smashing overhead attack greatly depletes a target's stamina, and easily breaks their guard.
weapons.upgradePath: Regular +10 (Hardstone); Quality +5: from +3 with Clearstone; Crushing +5: from +3 with Greystone; Dragon +5: from +3 with Dragonstone; Moon +5: from +6 with Moonlightstone; Blessed +5: from +6 with Faintstone; Morion Blade: Bastard Sword +8 + Storm Demon Soul (Blacksmith Ed)
weapons.location: Found in: Gates of Boletaria. Before the stairs with the rolling boulder, there's an inaccessible treasure on the lower level. Once the rolling boulder comes crashing down, you can drop yourself there and grab it.. | Dropped by: Scale Miner

weapons.name: Claymore
weapons.description: This very large sword, similar to a straight sword, is a versatile weapon, but its weight means it usually requeres the use of both hands. The smashing overhead attack greatly depletes a target's stamina, and easily breaks their guard.
weapons.upgradePath: Regular +10 (Sharpstone / Hardstone); Quality +5: from +3 with Clearstone; Crushing +5: from +3 with Greystone; Dragon +5: from +3 with Dragonstone; Moon +5: from +6 with Moonlightstone; Blessed +5: from +6 with Faintstone; Morion Blade: Claymore +8 + Storm Demon Soul (Blacksmith Ed)
weapons.location: Bought From: Dregling Merchant for 6000 souls. | Dropped by: Blue Eye Knight

weapons.name: Demonbrandt
weapons.description: A white blade made to be wielded against demons, held for generations by the Boletarian Royal Family. Paired with its counterpart, Soulbrandt, to form Northern Regalia. The less demonic the soul of the wielder, the more powerful this blade becomes. Hence Old King Allant's choice to wield Soulbrandt instead.
weapons.location: The Demonbrandt can only be obtained once per play through. In order to obtain the Demonbrandt you must obtain the Mausoleum Key from Ostrava. | In order to do this you must either save Ostrava throughout World 1, or kill him. If choose to save him, he will show up in The King's Tower right before the boss and will die when talked to. He will then drop the Mausoleum Key. | The key will also be dropped at where he died. | After obtaining the Mausoleum Key, go to Gates of Boletaria. Head forwards from the archstone to the large castle gates (Phalanx boss arena) and before the gate turn left. Enter the door and go up the stairs to the top of the tower. Once you reach the top, cross the bridge past the trebuchets to the other side, and at the end turn left. | After killing the Red Eye Knight, open the locked gate and approach Old King Doran. He will tell you that if you can prove yourself to him he will give you the sword. Players only need to take out 25% of his health. Attacking him further will cause him to turn hostile.

weapons.name: Flamberge
weapons.description: A unique large sword with a rippled blade. So named because of it's [sic] shape resembling a flame, the blade is made for rending flesh and forces the letting large amounts of blood. It is known especially as a weapon that easily causes mortal wounds.

weapons.name: Large Sword of Moonlight
weapons.description: The legendary large sword that reflects moonlight. Widely known in association with Moonlight Knight Vito. It's one of the few Revelations from God. The blue crystal blade is composed only of light, so it's impossible to block with a shield.
weapons.upgradePath: Unique weapon: upgraded with Colorless Demon Souls at Blacksmith Ed (after the Searing Demon Soul), 1 per level, max +5
weapons.location: Found in: Swamp of Sorrow, where you find the nest of Phosphorescent Slugs. Once you hit it enough times, many slugs will drop to the ground. Now go to where they've fallen and you will find the sword, among all the hostile slugs.

weapons.name: Northern Regalia
weapons.description: Old symbol of the King of Boletaria. The shape of this blade unites both Soulbrandt and Demonbrandt as one. Even Boletarian Royal Family legend scarcely mentions its origins, but it is believed that a malicious force left it behind in this world, along with the Old One.
weapons.upgradePath: Northern Regalia: Northern Regalia +0 + False King Demon Soul (Blacksmith Ed)
weapons.location: Can be created at Blacksmith Ed requires a False King Demon Soul. | It must be created by having both of the following: | Soulbrandt +0 | Demonbrandt +0 | Note: as a boss weapon it requires the player to beat the Flamelurker and give the Searing Demon Soul to Blacksmith Ed in order to craft it.

weapons.name: Morion Blade
weapons.description: A gnarled, thorny large sword of black quartz. Forged from the soul of the Demon "Storm King," it is actually the marrow of the storm beasts. These beasts take pleasure in the wielder's peril, and in these situations, the blade's attack power is greatly increased.
weapons.upgradePath: Morion Blade: Morion Blade +0 + Storm Demon Soul (Blacksmith Ed)
weapons.location: Can be created at Blacksmith Ed requires a Storm Demon Soul. | Can be created using any of the following: | Short Sword +8 | Long Sword +8 | Knight Sword +8 | Bastard Sword +8 | Claymore +8 | Great Sword +8

weapons.name: Soulbrandt
weapons.description: A blade that can cut the very soul, held for generations by the Boletarian Royal Family. Paired with its counterpart, Demonbrandt, to form Northern Regalia. Since his coronation, the sword has never left King Allant's side. The closer the soul of the wielder is to a demon, the more powerful this blade becomes. No wonder it was chosen by Old King Allant.
weapons.location: There is only one chance to obtain this sword each playthrough. | At the very end of the game, enter The Old One and fight King Allant | After the battle, the Soulbrandt will be on the ground next to where he died.

weapons.name: Storm Ruler
weapons.description: A large sword with a thorny, spiraled blade. Now abandoned and most of its power lost, it seems that it once dominated foes, but in an area with ancestral spirits or a monolith forest, you may be able to see it's past sky-cutting power.
weapons.location: There is only one chance to obtain this sword per play through. | When you enter Altar of Storms to fight the Storm King, turn to your right and follow the path downhill towards where all the Storm Beast are flying. | If you bear left before you approach the ruined building you will enter a flat area with rubble of broken monuments. | Towards the center there are 2 Crystal Lizards, and to their left, you will see a weapon stuck into the earth. That is the Storm Ruler. If you wish to grab it to fight the boss and enemies here, you will have to evade their attacks as you run to collect it (the Thief's Ring will help), and you will probably startle and scare off the lizards.

weapons.name: Dragon Bone Smasher
weapons.description: A bladeless, thick mass of iron used for smashing. According to the ancestors of Stonefang's excavators, it's said this weapon was created to face dragons, and is imbued with magic to protect the wielder from fire.
weapons.upgradePath: Unique weapon: upgraded with Colorless Demon Souls at Blacksmith Ed (after the Searing Demon Soul), 5, max +5
weapons.location: Found in: Underground Temple, Pure White World Tendency required. The debris on the left path will be cleared, beyond which you will find a unique Dragon Bone Smasher.

weapons.name: Great Sword
weapons.description: An extremely large straight sword. Similar to a large straight sword, but it's too heavy to wield with ordinary strength. Using that weight can blow enemies away. In recent times, Biorr of the Twin Fangs is known as the wielder of this weapon.

weapons.location: Dropped by: Red Eye Knight | Found in: Inner Ward, on the balcony next to the Dregling Merchant.

weapons.name: Blind
weapons.description: A curved sword with a perfectly transparent blade. Selen Vinland, the dull-gold knight, was famously dauntless, and this sword was equally well-known as a Vinland family treasure. The blade is illusory, and as light as a feather, allowing it to pass through any shield's defenses.
weapons.upgradePath: Unique weapon: upgraded with Colorless Demon Souls at Blacksmith Ed (after the Searing Demon Soul), 5, max +4
weapons.location: Dropped by: Black Phantom Selen Vinland at Swamp of Sorrow.

weapons.name: Falchion
weapons.description: A standard curved sword. A slash-based weapon, whose main attack — by way of thrusting the blade — inflicts heavy damage upon soft flesh, but conversely has limited effect on metal armor, or hard scales. Also, it causes the target to bleed.

weapons.description: A unique curved sword especially designed to counter shields. It can be awkward to use, but a wielder who can control it can greatly reduce the effectiveness of the enemy's guard. It has an ominous silhouette, and is said to be favored by a certain group of assassins.

Extremely difficult to handle owing to the fact that it must be held by the blade, inevitably injuring the wielder.
weapons.upgradePath: Unique weapon: upgraded with Colorless Demon Souls at Blacksmith Ed (after the Searing Demon Soul), 5, max +5
weapons.location: Found in: The Ritual Path, on a small room in the area full of Slugs. It is being protected by four Phosphorescent Slug. | Dropped by: Black Phantom Satsuki

weapons.name: Magic Sword "Makoto"
weapons.description: A cursed katana that has appeared in folklore through the ages. Named for Makoto the giant, who lived in a distant land. Countless, unique teeth have been carved into its blade. These teeth ravage the flesh, never to heal again. Cursed weapons, like the Makoto, are said to devour the wielder's essence and rob their warmth. Innumerable warriors continue to be taken by the Makoto's allure nevertheless.
weapons.upgradePath: Unique weapon: upgraded with Colorless Demon Souls at Blacksmith Ed (after the Searing Demon Soul), 5, max +5
weapons.location: Found in: Fort The Ritual Path, after the first reaper on a rock in the hole that Patches the Hyena kicks you in (Pure White World Tendency required)

weapons.name: Uchigatana
weapons.description: A keen, thinly bladed katana forged in a distant country. The long black blade is heavier than it looks. It has very high attack power and causes enemies to bleed, but the fragile blade is easily nicked.
